Maya (PM): Quick decision needed: GA stance on reserved pools when customers exceed commit during peak. Options: soft fallback (documented) or paid guaranteed burst windows. Thoughts?
Ibrahim (Eng): Soft fallback is safest to ship quickly. Implement tiered fallback: cheaper variant -> short queue -> best-effort spot. Need config knobs for queue_ms and burst_tokens.
Sana (SRE): Observability gate is non-negotiable. We need per-tenant burn-rate, fallback triggers, and a circuit-breaker to protect cluster. Alert if token burn > 2x baseline for 1 min.
Kai (Sales): Enterprise customers want guaranteed burst windows and carryover. Sales will only commit to pilots with clear SLA numbers and remediation (credits).
Maya (PM): Proposal: GA = soft fallback default; offer paid guaranteed-burst pilot with SLA and explicit preemption rules.
Ibrahim (Eng): Work estimate: soft fallback + telemetry = 3 weeks; SLA-ready guarantees (strict routing, pinned tokens) = 6-8 weeks.
Sana (SRE): Action: I will spec telemetry and canary alerts.
Kai (Sales): I'll draft SLA templates if product confirms guarantees.
Maya (PM): If no objections, lock plan and start RFC for soft fallback today. React :thumbsup: to approve.
